name: Miss Inconspicuous Maid Cleaning Co.!
source:
Welcome to Miss Inconspicuous Maid Cleaning Co.! Follow (or decide) the story of Ellie, a completely normal girl in a completely normal society, in this completely normal job!

[from [url=https://cinnamew.itch.io/mimco]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到隐形小姐清洁公司！跟随（或决定）艾莉的故事，一个完全正常社会中完全正常的女孩，从事这份完全正常的工作！
